## Behavior and scope

Describe the concrete user behavior and link the spec/issue.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant offline tests actually passed (include command/output summary).
- [ ] UI changes were checked in the browser.
- [ ] Every new/changed behavior has linked test evidence and a sanitized log/run
      when applicable; unavailable evidence is explicitly identified.
- [ ] Golden questions were not deleted/weakened; real failures were retained.
- [ ] No keys, private answers, images or raw prompts were added.
- [ ] Delegation entry describes actual work and review.

## Human review

Name the teammate who reviewed the diff and tests. Do not tick for agent-only review.
